<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern—a strong M+1 peak (~16 % of the base peak) indicating many carbon atoms, and a modest M+2 peak (~5 % of the base) matching the natural abundance of ^34S—we can definitively identify carbon and sulfur in the sample. No chlorine‑ or bromine‑type patterns are present.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
